definition: the observation the env returned on the fatal step; one entry per failed episode
stored_space: the 29-dim learner STATE. crl/train.py slices it to goal coordinates with config.goal_indices, so the same bank file serves the XY (2) and XYV (8) goal contracts.
extraction_moment: settle 0 -- the step V5 itself reports the death on. Post-mortem settling was measured (see scripts/probe_v5_failure_representation.py) and REJECTED: it drives the death state toward zero velocity, i.e. toward the expert HOLD, which is the behaviour the benchmark wants preserved.

class_definitions.random: uniform torque; measured to produce no task-relevant failures on this benchmark (never reaches the band)
class_definitions.noisy: walking controller + Gaussian action noise, blind (NOISY-CONTROLLER, not uniform random)
class_definitions.blind: walking controller, no noise, timetable never read
class_definitions.deliberate: sighted expert read the timetable, decided WAIT, overridden to GO
class_definitions.mistimed: sighted expert waited, released early, entered while the burst was still open

sampling: stratified without replacement, largest-remainder rounding; a short pool is a hard error, never a top-up or a duplicate
privileged_selection_note: CLASS SELECTION ONLY. The stored vectors are 29-dim learner states and carry no provenance; the sidecar fields decided WHICH of them are kept, nothing else. A bank built this way is a curated training artifact, not something the learner could have derived.
